g.text: Did the new methods improve the balance across groups?

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172d43

g.text: Balanced score = average of the groups' success rates. Every eligible group gets equal weight.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172d43

g.text: Compare methods within each panel. Original localities and the proposed two-group question are different tasks.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172d43

g.text: Small sample, repeated use of the same specimens. The slight upper-locality gain is descriptive; no corrected test meets 0.05.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #758392

g.text: The dashed line is a simple benchmark, not a statistical significance threshold. No species-identification accuracy is measured here.
